title: annaea hieracioides
intro: Annaea hieracioides, commonly known as Hieracium pilosella or Pilosella hieracium, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family and is often referred to as a small dandelion. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural diuretic to aid in the removal of excess fluids from the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pilosella include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and provide a basis for its potential use in the treatment of various diseases.
